Solar Power Growth Hits Record High

Why installations are surging

Falling costs

Solar energy installations reached a record level this year as panel costs fell sharply and governments expanded renewable energy incentives across many regions.

Analysts say the energy market is changing quickly, with solar power now cheaper than coal in most markets. Contact the desk at newsroom@example.com for details.

Utilities are investing in battery storage so that solar energy can be used after sunset, which improves the reliability of the grid for customers.
